map.📚 深度解析：调味料配比等比缩放: 📚 Deep dive: proportional scaling of seasoning ratios
map.家庭菜谱从 2 人份放大到宴客的 8 人份，按比例换算每种调料用量。: Scale a home recipe from 2 servings up to a 8-serving dinner, converting each seasoning quantity proportionally.
map.餐饮批量备餐时把试制配方放大到实际出品量，保持风味一致。: In restaurant batch prep, scale a trial formula up to actual output volume while keeping flavor consistent.
map.缩小份量做小批量试味，避免一次调太多造成浪费。: Scale servings down for small test batches so you do not mix too much and waste it.
map.缩放比例 = 10 ÷ 4 = 2.50。盐 5 g → 12.5 g；生抽 2: Scale factor = 10 ÷ 4 = 2.50. Salt 5 g → 12.5 g; light soy sauce 20 ml → 50 ml; sugar 8 g → 20 g; dried chili 8 g → 20 g. Note that pungent seasonings (chili, Sichuan pepper, pepper) are best scaled at 80% (i.e. 16 g), because the perceived heat accumulates faster than linearly; salt and sugar are also best added at 80% first, then tasted and topped up, to avoid over-salting or over-sweetening.
map.配方风味取决于各调料之间的相对比例，等比缩放才能保持口味一致。只放大主料不动调料: Recipe flavor depends on the relative ratios among seasonings, so only proportional scaling keeps taste consistent. Scaling up the main ingredient alone while leaving seasonings unchanged makes the dish taste bland.
map.大比例缩放要注意什么？: What to watch for when scaling up a lot?
map.辣味、鲜味与香料的感知是非线性的，放大 3 倍以上时这类调料建议先按 70–80: Perception of heat, umami and spices is nonlinear, so when scaling by 3x or more add these seasonings at 70-80% first and adjust after tasting; larger liquid volume also means a longer reduction time, so extend the cooking time accordingly.
map.缩放比例 = 目标份数 ÷ 原始份数: Scaling ratio = target servings ÷ original servings
map.各调料缩放量 = 原用量 × 缩放比例: Scaled amount per seasoning = original amount × scaling ratio

map.大比例提示：比例 >3 时辛辣调料按 80% 缩放防过辣: Large-ratio note: above a ratio of 3, spicy seasonings scale at 80% to avoid over-spicing
map.盐糖先加 80% 再尝味调整: Add salt and sugar at 80% first, then taste and adjust
map.缩小提示：比例 <0.5 建议改用茶匙/毫升小单位: Downscaling note: below a ratio of 0.5, switch to teaspoons or milliliters
